<h:html xmlns:h="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:orx="http://openrosa.org/jr/xforms" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2002/xforms" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:jr="http://openrosa.org/javarosa" xmlns:vellum="http://commcarehq.org/xforms/vellum">
	<h:head>
		<h:title>Survey</h:title>
		<model>
			<instance>
				<data xmlns:jrm="http://dev.commcarehq.org/jr/xforms" xmlns="http://openrosa.org/formdesigner/ac444d56-0127-4afe-98d9-771757c04f18" uiVersion="1" version="3" name="Survey">
					<started_at />
					<finished_at />
					<order />
					<code />
					<kind_name />
					<visits jr:template="">
						<visit_code />
						<visit_kind />
					</visits>
					<language />
					<code_again />
				</data>
			</instance>
			<instance id="item-list:kinds" src="jr://fixture/item-list:kinds" />
			<instance id="commcaresession" src="jr://instance/session" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/started_at" nodeset="/data/started_at" type="xsd:dateTime" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/finished_at" nodeset="/data/finished_at" type="xsd:dateTime" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/order" nodeset="/data/order" vellum:calculate="if(#form/finished_at > #form/started_at, 'after', 'not after')" calculate="if(/data/finished_at > /data/started_at, 'after', 'not after')" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/code" nodeset="/data/code" type="xsd:string" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/kind_name" nodeset="/data/kind_name" vellum:calculate="instance('item-list:kinds')/kinds_list/kinds[code = #form/code]/name" calculate="instance('item-list:kinds')/kinds_list/kinds[code = /data/code]/name" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/visits" nodeset="/data/visits" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/visits/visit_code" nodeset="/data/visits/visit_code" type="xsd:string" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/visits/visit_kind" nodeset="/data/visits/visit_kind" vellum:calculate="instance('item-list:kinds')/kinds_list/kinds[code = #form/visits/visit_code]/name" calculate="instance('item-list:kinds')/kinds_list/kinds[code = /data/visits/visit_code]/name" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/language" nodeset="/data/language" calculate="instance('commcaresession')/session/context/applanguage" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/code_again" nodeset="/data/code_again" type="xsd:string" />
			<setvalue event="xforms-ready" vellum:ref="#form/code_again" ref="/data/code_again" vellum:value="#form/code" value="/data/code" />
			<itext>
				<translation lang="en" default="">
					<text id="started_at-label">
						<value>Started at</value>
					</text>
					<text id="finished_at-label">
						<value>Finished at</value>
					</text>
					<text id="code-label">
						<value>Visit kind code</value>
					</text>
					<text id="visits-label">
						<value>Visits</value>
					</text>
					<text id="visits/visit_code-label">
						<value>Visit code</value>
					</text>
					<text id="code_again-label">
						<value>Visit kind code again</value>
					</text>
				</translation>
			</itext>
		</model>
	</h:head>
	<h:body>
		<input vellum:ref="#form/started_at" ref="/data/started_at">
			<label ref="jr:itext('started_at-label')" />
		</input>
		<input vellum:ref="#form/finished_at" ref="/data/finished_at">
			<label ref="jr:itext('finished_at-label')" />
		</input>
		<input vellum:ref="#form/code" ref="/data/code">
			<label ref="jr:itext('code-label')" />
		</input>
		<group>
			<label ref="jr:itext('visits-label')" />
			<repeat vellum:nodeset="#form/visits" nodeset="/data/visits">
				<input vellum:ref="#form/visits/visit_code" ref="/data/visits/visit_code">
					<label ref="jr:itext('visits/visit_code-label')" />
				</input>
			</repeat>
		</group>
		<input vellum:ref="#form/code_again" ref="/data/code_again">
			<label ref="jr:itext('code_again-label')" />
		</input>
	</h:body>
</h:html>"}}
